title: Private Sunset Boat Cruise in Duck
includes: Life Jacket, anchor, ladder, fuel, United States Coast Guard licensed captain.
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
The Currituck Sound Sunset Cruise is a private captained boat experience departing from Duck, designed for groups of up to 20 guests. This relaxed evening cruise offers a scenic way to enjoy the Outer Banks from the water, with calm soundside cruising, colorful sunset views, and opportunities to spot local wildlife along the way. Guests can bring their own drinks and snacks, enjoy a customizable route based on weather and group preferences, and take in a peaceful golden-hour experience ideal for family gatherings, celebrations, and special occasions.

Itinerary
Meet at the Kitty Hawk Kites location in Duck at 1226 Duck Rd, Duck, NC 27949. Check in at the Adventure Kiosk on the Duck Boardwalk. Meet 15 minutes BEFORE the departure time.

Cancellations
Customers will receive a full refund or credit with 24 hours notice of cancellation. Customers will also receive a full refund or credit in case of operator cancellation due to weather or other unforeseen circumstances.
